# Hecate

> Enterprise-grade, multi-tenant, model-agnostic, MCP-first Agent platform with a self-developed Pregel execution engine. Built with Python 3.12+, FastAPI, and SQLAlchemy 2.0 async. Self-hosted; speaks MCP and A2A natively; integrates 100+ LLMs via LiteLLM; exposes an OpenAI-compatible API.

Hecate's documentation follows the Diátaxis framework: tutorials (learn), how-to guides (work), reference (look up), and concepts/explanation (understand) — plus an Architecture Center with deep dives and ADRs, operations runbooks, and migration guides.

## Getting started
- [Quickstart](docs/getting-started/quickstart.md): install, start infra, run migrations, send your first chat request in ~5 minutes

## Concepts (explanation)
- [Overview](docs/concepts/overview.md): what Hecate is and how the pieces fit together
- [Agents and Execution Modes](docs/concepts/agents.md): the chat / three_layer / workflow modes
- [The Execution Engine](docs/concepts/engine.md): Pregel/BSP runtime — graphs, channels, supersteps, checkpoints
- [Context Engineering](docs/concepts/context-engineering.md): the per-call context pipeline, token budgets, offloading
- [Memory System](docs/concepts/memory.md): the four-level memory architecture (L1–L4)
- [Guardrails and Hooks](docs/concepts/guardrails.md): the four engine-level hook types
- [Data Loss Prevention (DLP)](docs/concepts/dlp.md): outbound detection engine — recognizers, policy, actions, five trust boundaries
- [Multi-Tenancy](docs/concepts/multi-tenancy.md): Organization → Workspace → User isolation
- [Agent Evaluation](docs/concepts/evaluation.md): datasets, evaluators, runs, and scores
